blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ما جاء في دعاء النبي ﷺ.... رقم:٧٣٧٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) says, “The Prophet ﷺ appointed a man as the leader of a group and sent him off; he used to lead his companions in Salah. (Whatever surah he recited, he would finish at the end by reciting Surah “Qul huwallahu”. After they returned, they informed the Prophet ﷺ about this. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Ask him himself why he did so', and the people asked him. He said, “In this surah the attributes of ar-Rahman are described; therefore my heart loves to recite it often.' When the Prophet ﷺ heard this reply of his, he said, “Tell him the news that Allah too loves him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ اِذَا اَوَي اِلَي فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيْهِمَا فَقَرَأَ فِيْهِمَا:(قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ اَحَدٌ۞)، وَ(قُلْ اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ۞)، وَ(قُلْ اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاس۞)، ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ، يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلي رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا اَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ، يَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب ما يقول عند النوم رقم:٥٠٥٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the Prophet ﷺ went to sleep at night, he would put both his palms together, recite Surah Qul huwallahu, Surah Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq and Surah Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas, blow into his palms and wipe them over his body as far as his hands could reach; he would begin first with the head, and wipe over the face and the front of the body. He would do this three times. This was a practice the Prophet ﷺ regularly did every night”, says Hazrat Aishah (RA).
